product_metadata.title: Brew Tapper Kettle Screen for Brew Kettle or Mash Tun
features: The best 304 stainless steel mashing/boiling bazooka kettle screen
Excellent to use for straining hops in a boil or in mash tun instead of a false bottom
12 inch stainless steel mesh screen in length and 1 inch in diameter, get great results
1/2 inch MPT fitting on one end to fit in brew kettle or any line of weld less ball valves
This screen is heavy duty, makes a perfect companion for your mash tun or boiling kettle
description: Everywhere our customers are raving about this kettle screen. This is the best stainless steel mesh to replace a false bottom in a mash tun or boil kettle for lautering worth or filtering whole hops. A must have! You cannot beat the convenience of a stainless steel multi-purpose mash/boil mesh screen. This all stainless steel kettle brewing screen is made from heavy duty 304 stainless steel. It can be used for straining hops in a boil or for use in a mash tun instead of using a false bottom. The screen is 12" in length, 1" in diameter, with a 1/2" MPTT fitting at one end. This fitting will thread directly into the inside of your brew kettle, or into the back of any line of weld-less ball valves, allowing you to better filter trub or whole hops from your worth while transferring from your kettle to your fermenter. Excellent for straining out leaf hops in the boil kettle (pellet hops can clog the screen). We also have several customers who use this as a screen in their cooler mash tun.
